notes: execute (2 x 4,930 lines) and lockAcquired (1,790 lines) were reviewed by structure: command/action dispatch, loops, external calls, reverts. The 13 source loops (UniversalRouter.execute command loop; Permit2Payments batch check; StableSwapRouter._stableSwap (inlined twice); V2SwapRouter._v2Swap (twice); V3SwapRouter.v3SwapExactInput while(true); UniversalRouterHelper.getStableAmountsIn and getAmountInMultihop (both shown as 'while s:' counting down); BaseActionsRouter action loop; CLRouterBase/BinRouterBase exact-in and exact-out path loops; the Yul for of CalldataDecoder.decodeActionsRouterParams (lockAcquired and EXECUTE_SUB_PLAN)) are all readable while loops; the 58 whiles are 13 per dispatch copy x 4 copies (2 per execute, see the P12 finding) + 6 in lockAcquired, including 3 implicit ABI-encoding loops per copy (sub-plan bytes[], PermitBatch details, AllowanceTransferDetails[]). Checked exactly: v3 exact-in loop (toInt256 require, hasMultiplePools as 66 <= len, skipToken as +23, Panic(17) on negating int256.min, V3TooLittleReceived), pancakeV3SwapCallback (recursive exact-out swap with sqrt limits MIN+1/MAX-1, maxAmountIn from transient storage), stable exact-in (CONTRACT_BALANCE / ALREADY_PAID / pay vs permit2), successRequired as bit 255 of the command word, ExecutionFailed, isNotLocked/whenNotPaused/checkDeadline, owner functions (Ownable2Step), setStableSwap (stor3 shares its slot with paused: the text writes the address field only, consistent with def storage). Names: stableSwapFactory/stableSwapInfo are stor2/stor3 and most custom errors are raw selectors (not in the signature database).
summary: Faithful and its loops are all found, but very hard to read: the 2,460-line dispatcher is printed twice in each execute function, 213 calls and 90 reverts lose their selector because mem[_v len 4] is not matched with the store through mem[64], and nested calldata offsets are recomputed in every access.
